name: Prime Video
description: Prime Video is a service of Amazon; the Prime subscription is carried within Amazon Seller Services Pvt Ltd in India. Following the June 2024 MX Player acquisition, the ad-supported tier runs under Amazon MX Player. No standalone Prime Video India financials are disclosed.

stock.note: No standalone entity; reflects parent Amazon.com Inc ~$262.07 (Aug 25, 2026).

marketing_spend.derivation: No standalone India financials, so Tiers 1-3 don't apply. Prime Video is a top-tier OTT advertiser in India via tentpole originals, sports promos and the MX Player free tier. Given campaign presence comparable to Netflix/JioHotstar, this triangulates to ~₹300-600 crore/year — a rough, low-confidence estimate that likely partially overlaps Amazon India's consolidated ad spend.
